card.name: Slash or 'and' between paired transporters
card.fires_on: The slash, 'or' or 'and' joining two named transporters or receptors in a list, mostly after OCT2 in metformin elimination text. It fires just before the second name (MATE, GR).

modes.label: Slash after OCT2
modes.description: A slash joins OCT2 to the next transporter, multidrug and toxin extrusion (MATE).

modes.label: Or/and between targets
modes.description: A short joining word links two transporters or receptors that a drug acts on.
